anomalous_high_school.name: Anomalous High: Academy & Incursions
anomalous_high_school.dropdown_label: Anomalous High: Academy & Incursions [Urban Fantasy • High School • Horror]
anomalous_high_school.description: A modern metropolis where anomalous incursions are public knowledge and {session_school} sits at the heart of the city. Play either as an adult field operative for one of the city's agencies, or as an awakened high school student who attends classes by day and takes freelance anomaly contracts after the final bell.
anomalous_high_school.tone_guidelines: Blend grounded high school slice-of-life (classes, clubs, friendships, gossip) with eerie urban anomaly horror. Keep the school day feeling ordinary so that anomalies intruding on it feel unsettling. Student characters are students first: they worry about exams, curfews and classmates as well as containment.
